Subject: Re: Rollback simulation & War Room readiness (prep) — results and closure

Summary of the simulation run (results attached):
- Rollback simulation executed: rollback-sim v2 against staging replica at 2027-04-22T10:35 PDT. Script completed successfully in 3m42s.
- Smoke checks: 48/50 checks passed. Two transient anomalies observed:
  1) Short 12s DNS resolution spike affecting one ingress host (recovered automatically).
  2) One model container reported elevated OOM warnings during warm-up; pod recycled and stabilized before traffic cutover.
- Observability: traces and token-cost telemetry populated in Console; two alerts fired (DNS spike and OOM warning) and were auto-correlated to SUP-5482.
- War Room flow: Connor opened SUP-5482 at 10:31 PDT, documented each major action, and closed the ticket after verification at 11:08 PDT.

Attached: smoke-run-results-20270422.csv, war-room-closure-checklist.md. No customer impact observed. Recommend:
- Add a pre-cutover DNS TTL check to the runbook (small edit).
- Increase model container memory buffer for the specific model family that showed OOM warnings.

Next steps:
- Marissa: include the two recommended edits in runbook v2 and circulate.
- Connor: keep SUP-5482 archived with timestamps and attach the CSV.
- Schedule a 30-minute postmortem review next week to capture any automation work.

Thanks everyone — closing this simulation as successful.

Soojin Lee
Principal SRE, Redwood Inference
